MINUTES

  ADJOURNED CITY COUNCIL MEETING

  SEPTEMBER 26, 2017

An adjourned meeting of the City Council of Rolling Hills Estates was called to order at
4:05 p.m. in the City Council Chambers, 4045 Palos Verdes Drive North, by MAYOR
ZERUNYAN.

City Council Members Present:  Huff*, Mitchell, Schmitz, Zuckerman and
  Mayor Zerunyan
  *Council Member Huff arrived at 4:20 p.m.

City Council Members Absent:  None.

City Staff Present:  City Manager Doug Prichard
  Assistant City Manager Greg Grammer
  Planning Director David Wahba
  Senior Planner Jeannie Naughton

DISCUSSION ITEM: CALIFORNIA WATER COMPANY PIPELINE PROJECT

The City Council heard a presentation from California Water Company representatives
responding to previously raised Council concerns regarding alignment of a major pipeline
replacement project that would require work in the Palos Verdes Drive North right of way
during the summer months of 2018.

Extensive discussion then ensued regarding the scheduling challenges of this alignment
in light of the heavy traffic volumes on the road, with the suggested alternative raised by
MAYOR ZERUNYAN discussed in detail. Consensus of Cal-Water and the COUNCIL was
that the alignment in Palos Verdes Drive North would require full closure of the
eastbound lane between Dapplegray School and Dapplegray Lane during construction
and that use of the off-road bike path as a travel lane was impractical and potentially
unsafe. MAYOR ZERUNYAN voiced his opposition to this traffic control plan.

Further discussion ensued regarding the project, as it would be defined and considered
by the environmental consultant, and potential study issues and outcomes of the
environmental review.

ADJOURNMENT

At 5:05 p.m., MAYOR ZERUNYAN formally adjourned the City Council meeting to an
adjourned meeting scheduled for Tuesday, September 26, 2017 beginning at 5:00 p.m.
for the purpose of conducting interviews with applicants to the Planning Commission
and General Plan Advisory Committee.
